steps.title: 👋 Welcome to Config Portal
steps.description: Let's get you set up in under 2 minutes. We'll create a project, add an environment, and create your first config flag.

steps.title: Create or select a project
steps.description: Projects group your configs by app or service. Click here to create one.

steps.title: Set up an environment
steps.description: Navigate to Settings to create your first environment (e.g., production, staging).

steps.title: Now let's create a config
steps.description: Head to the Configs tab to add your first feature flag.

steps.title: Create your first config
steps.description: Click here to add a feature flag or configuration value.

steps.title: 🎉 You're all set!
steps.description: Your first config is ready. Next, grab your API key from the API Keys tab and integrate the SDK into your app.
